title: dream boy at mallworld
content: i can’t tell if i’m in a mall or a movie theater or both but i dream of this place so often. a few weeks ago i found myself trying to escape from the mall, although i don’t remember what i was running from. there were other people there and i ended up running out the front doors with this guy. we waited outside in a tent and talked for a while but i don’t remember the conversation. then we smoked a cigarette and that’s when i woke up! i love to imagine we’re meeting other dreamers in these moments bc something about the mallworld dreams just feels so different. it’s like places like malls/airports/movie theaters are very much in-between zones. my “normal” dreams usually follow some kind of complicated plot and almost always include friends or family or people from my elementary school for some reason. but it’s specifically mallworld where its extremely vivid and really does feel like strangers just passing through.
